sources.excerpt: P012 – Constellation OD – Collateral FX About Pedals Boost Buffer Chorus Compressor Distortion Fuzz Modulation Overdrive Preamp Vibe Vibrato Search Toggle Menu About Pedals Boost Buffer Chorus Compressor Distortion Fuzz Modulation Overdrive Preamp Vibe Vibrato Home » Pedals » Overdrive » P012 – Constellation OD + + + P012 – Constellation OD Active ingredient – Asymmetric hard clipping and an explosion of harmonics. Recommended for – Those seeking an incredibly versatile overdrive that ranges from a crunch to almost distortion, with perfect mids to cut through the mix. The Constellation OD is arguably the most versatile single overdrive from Collateral. Acting as a crystal-clear buffer when in bypass, its structure harks back to the low-mid gain tones of the ProCo Rat. However, the Constellation features asymmetric clipping, offering odd harmonics with a beautiful and complex texture, while keeping its bass intact, unlike its rodent cousin. Moreover, the Constellation operates from 9 to 18v, providing the guitarist with more or less headroom and compression, making it an excellent pedal to push an amplifier already on the edge-of-breakup. Its definition and string separation make it an exceptional pedal for playing everything from blues, rock, fusion, and even jazz!
